iona.name: Iona Vale
iona.palette: Warm brown, plum, lavender and copper. Short natural black hair, copper temple bead.

ren.name: Ren Sato
ren.palette: Light olive, ink black and teal. Asymmetric short hair with one teal strand.

shots.speaker: iona
shots.text: The relay has one minute before it shuts itself down. I can move the heat. I need you to tell me where it's going.

shots.speaker: ren
shots.text: If the tile cools after we open another path, how do we know the processor didn't just slow down? The display only shows temperature.

shots.speaker: iona
shots.text: Hold the power at six watts. Hold the sink at twenty degrees. Change one thing. Give the heat a second path, just like the first.

shots.speaker: ren
shots.text: One path. Four degrees per watt. That's a rise of twenty-four degrees above the sink. The model puts the tile at forty-four.

shots.speaker: iona
shots.text: Two equal paths. Three watts down each. Each path now rises twelve degrees above the sink. The tile lands at thirty-two.

shots.speaker: ren
shots.text: That's the ideal model. A loose contact could spoil the split. Next time we measure both paths and see if they're really equal.

shots.speaker: iona
shots.text: The relay can wait for a better answer. Leave both sensors on.
